description: Two checks on a Solana token mint. (1) Authenticity: if it claims to be a tokenized stock or real-world asset, is it the issuer's real token or an impersonator, and is the backing verifiable? (2) Launch trust: who deployed it, how their previous launches ended, bundling and funding-trail flags, with a pass / caution / fail verdict. Every pass/fail verdict is re-graded at 24h and 7d on a public scoreboard. Free.
name: check_token
title: Check a token before you buy it
